dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
Start talking.
说吧。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
Mmph! Mmmmf!
嗯呜呜！！！嗯呜！！！

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
... Can't spill with your trap covered?
……嘴被堵上就说不了话吗。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
*huff* What do you expect?! You taped my mouth shut—how was I supposed to talk?!
呼啊！那肯定的吧！！嘴被胶带封住了还怎么说话啊！

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
Beats me. Here in Hongyuan, you see it at least every 3 or 4 days—Folk who can make their voice heard without even using their mouths.
是吗。在鸿园里，不是每隔两三天就能见到一个不用嘴就能说话的家伙吗。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
That's because they've consumed Boluses!
那得是用了相应的丸的家伙才行吧……

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
You Shi sure are a bunch of talk-too-much bastards.
你们史家全都是这种喋喋不休的家伙啊……

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
Eeek?!
噫？！

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
I-I'm begging you, spare me! Just this once...
饶、饶命。饶命啊！饶我这次就好……

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
I... I'll do anything. Anything! Please just don't kill me... I've already been resuscitated twice through the Life Insurance. Th-the third time might really melt my brain beyond the point of no return!
我、我什么都会做的所以别杀我……我已经复活过两次了，第、第三次说不定整个脑子都会化掉！！！

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
Hah... One of the most eminent families of Hongyuan, reduced to a pile of dogshit milksops...
哈啊……一个曾经如此名声显赫的家族，为何会堕落至如此地步。

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
S.Y.M.... Unless asked.
没·问·事……没·问·嘴·闭。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
... Huh? Wha—
……你在说，啥？

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
That peculiar way of speech... Y-you... you're that Lin woman, aren't you?!
这缩略说话的奇特方式……你、你……莫非是那个姓林的？

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
That tramp from some inconsequential family who curried up favor with Daguanyuan a few years back, serving as a bodyguard even though you're not from any of the Four Great Houses.
几年前说是个侍卫什么的，明明不是有钱有势的四大家族中的一员，却巴结上了大观园……

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
... Kitschy.
……真够刻奇的。

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
Even with a blade poised to slit your throat... still you run your tongue as if you've got a death wish.
明明面前有个人握着刀随时能切开你的喉咙……却还是能泰然自若地说出加速你死亡的话啊……

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
But your words ring true. Can't say you're a complete fool.
但你的话本身没错，所以也不能单纯说你是个蠢货。

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
You're not without aesthetic merit... Would be a waste to S.Y.N.C.
你姑且还有点美学价值……折·脖未免可惜了。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
S.Y.N—I... I've heard that one! It's something about snapping necks... W-wait, does that mean you're sparing me...?
折……是、是那个吧？折断脖子……那，放、放我一……

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
Gaaah!!
嘎啊啊！

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
Your arms are flailing about. Disgusting.
乱挥手臂令人不快。

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
Now spill—everything you know about the new Family Hierarch.
把你知道的有关新家主的事情全都说出来。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content: *sob* ... What? H-how would I know...? She's not even from my family! 呜呜……啥？我、我怎么会知道……她甚至不是我们家族的……

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
But you do know.
但你应该知道的。

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
The Shi, Wang, Xue... All of you joined hands and threw your weight behind that scum in the Family Hierarch war.
你们。史家、王家、薛家。在家主之争中，联手把一个人推了上去。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
How did you—
你是怎么……？

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content: You're not the only one who sings like a canary when persuaded. 叽叽喳喳说个不停的家伙可不止你一个。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
Khh... W-we had no other choice!
咕……不，我、我们没别的办法了！

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
The Jia Family would've seized the Hierarch's seat had we sat on our hands...! How could we possibly allow such a disgrace?!
放任不管的话，贾家又会轻而易举地夺走家主之位……难道我们能默许那种事情发生吗？

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
Besides... we were victims, too!
而且……我们也是受害者。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
True, we had a hand in her ascension, and yes, she did become the Hierarch in the end... But the moment she claimed the seat, she ignored every request we made!
虽然我们将那家伙推上了家主之位是事实，她也确实成了家主，可她坐稳位置后，便将我们说过的话全都抛之脑后了！

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
We only supported her because she'd promised to defer the land dues on our Hongyuan property... Yet as soon as the first Restructuring Day came after she became the Hierarch, she simply wiped the place out down to the last stone!
我们也是听了她会延长鸿园中营业场所的土地税支付期限的话才帮忙的……可重构日一到，她就把土地整平了啊？

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
You people distrusted your own family and thought things would work out if you backed another. Serves you right.
明明你们自家人之间都信不过，却还去托举其他家族的人，才会落得这般下场吧。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
No, no! That's not it...
不对、不对！不是这样的……

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
I... I'm bound by the contract. I can't go into too much detail... But she was supposed to keep her word!
虽、虽然详细情况因为合同不能说……但那家伙必须遵守与我们之间的约定。

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
For her to stab us behind our backs with such impunity... I'm certain it's more than just a simple change of heart...
既然她如此行事，说明她并不是单纯地改变了心意……

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
Th-this looks suspicious to me. E-even that soft-hearted fool you were a bodyguard to... yes, him!
总、总感觉很可疑啊。没错，那个……那个你保护的愣头青！

dataList.title:
Shi Family
史家
dataList.content:
Even if he had become the Family Hierarch with his cloud-chasing daydream of "a peaceful Hongyuan," he wouldn't have been any diff—
就算是他，那个妄想着和平鸿园的家伙成了家主，也肯定不会——

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
Excessive pursuit of the kitsch... becomes grotesque and repulsive.
过度追求刻奇的话，会在某一刻……让人十分不快。

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
... Since it's come to this... perhaps the Xue should be next on the list.
……既然事已至此，下一个就该是薛家了吧。

dataList.title:
Hongyuan
鸿园
dataList.content:
It's a risk, walking right into a tiger den to catch a tiger... But with what that blabbermouth said, I doubt they can turn a blind eye to this much longer.
虽然这就像是为了猎虎而闯入虎穴一般……但从这个说个没完的家伙的话来看，对面也没法对此一直装聋作哑下去吧。

With no clues gained, I came down to the market square. Every structure around me creaked and cracked, shuffling about and rearranging themselves like building blocks.
我没得到什么像样的收获，继而向着市场的方向返回，周围的建筑物发出咔啦咔啦的响声，四处移去。

It seems the Restructuring Days are getting more frequent.
重构日更加频繁了。

The last Restructuring was but 3 days ago—not a week has passed and people are already free-falling through the air.
明明三天前才调整过房屋，连一周都没过去，就又有人从空中坠落而下。

Now there aren't even the telltale tremors anymore. Forget escape—everything just snaps into motion in a heartbeat.
如今重构日连前兆也不再出现，一瞬间就会咔啦咔啦地启动起来，所以连最低限度的避难时间都没有了。

... So, the drizzle of people grew into a downpour.
……正因如此，人之雨从毛毛雨变成了倾盆大雨。

I'd heard for sure that Restructuring Days were a remnant of the old H Corp., locked in automated cycles. But not long after the new Family Hierarch ascended to the coveted seat, its behavior changed...
我确实听说过重构日的发生是旧H公司的残渣，本身是个自动运行的系统，可在新家主就位后不久就成了这副模样，也就是说……

... as though someone's hands were behind the wheel.
这完全称得上是有意为之的。

Then that fool's idea may not have been a fool's errand, after all.
这样一来，我不禁觉得那家伙说过的话也许真的能够实现。

The young master of the Jia Family who proclaimed that he would see the Restructuring Day gone the moment he ascends to the seat of the Family Hierarch.
他曾说过，要是自己成了家主，第一件事就是取消重构日……真是个只顾追逐浪漫的贾家人。

Back then, I'd brushed it off as the naive delusion of a sheltered young master...
我曾觉得他是个纨绔子弟，才如此沉迷于妄想……

But in hindsight... it may be so that I did not entirely dislike the idea.
但如今想来，我才发觉自己并非完全不喜欢他的想法。

Perhaps I saw an aesthetic quality within it.
说不定我曾在其中找到了美学。

The upper class of Hongyuan, the so-called leaders of Daguanyuan, are expected to take lives with impunity and deploy whatever underhanded tactic they could conjure to come out on top...
对于鸿园与大观园中的高位者来说，他们本应能够轻易杀人，无论何种阴谋诡计都能泰然自若地实施才对……

But he harbored this innocent, dreamy idea of saving those who'd fall to their meaningless deaths.
可比起那些，他却有着想要救下那些坠落而下、支离灭裂的人们的浪漫。

I still don't understand it, but...
我虽然仍未能够理解。

... the way his memory keeps resurfacing... I suppose he left his mark on me. Must've been a rather fine work of art I'd kept by my side, that one.
但在像这样不断回想他的话语之中，我似乎也被感化了。大概我的身旁就有着一幅十分优秀的佳作吧。

... I should've trained him harder, taught him how to defend himself better back when we were traveling to prepare for the first round of the Evaluation.
……果然，我早该在为了准备第一轮评审而四处奔波的时候，就多教他些武艺的。

I look up at Hongyuan's artificial sky with a hollow chuckle, catching glimpses of black bamboo hats amidst the pelting rain of people.
我发出空洞的笑声，抬头望向鸿园那无比狭仄的人造天空，在倾盆而下的人之雨中，我看见了漆黑的斗笠。

Someone's sent the Zi branch after me.
子被放出来了。

It seems that the leash-holding bluebloods have taken notice of the trail of bodies I've left behind in my search for the thread of clues. The thread that will bring me to the Family Hierarch.
也就是说，在我为了寻找与家主有关的线索而四处杀人的时候，那些握有辔头的大人物也已经留意到我了吗。

No one but that girl is of any interest to me in Hongyuan. Hmph, it is indeed true that those who care overmuch for their own lives tend to jump at their own shadows.
在这鸿园之中，除一人外，其余我都不感兴趣……可也真是，那些十分在意自己性命的家伙们，心中似乎都藏了不少鬼啊。

Nevertheless, this is a decent opportunity. If I can trace this back to whoever it is that sent the Rats... maybe I can leverage the fact they came for my life to find another thread that should lead me to the Family Hierarch.
这机会也不差。若是追查以此为借口而放出黑兽的家伙，或许就能以对面意图谋害我为由，再次得到通往家主的线索。

That single thread is all I need.
一条线索就足够了。

I have no wish to follow that fool's will, nor do I wish to become a blade of rebellion...
我既不想继承那家伙的遗志，也不想成为易姓的凶刃……

... but Hongyuan's degradation has mutated it into a thing of such hideousness that it harbors not even a trace of beauty in its filth.
但如今的鸿园，丑恶间连一丝美丽都找寻不出，已经彻底沦为了拙作。

Well...
不过……

... going no further than to add another layer of critique to the pile with this long brush should be more to my temperament, anyway.
用这支长笔对着作品指摘一二，倒是挺合我的性子的。
